task.description:
WF-02 Step Final — Git merge for REQ-070.

All pipeline gates PASSED (design, implementation, security, idiom, test-design, test-run, release-validation, doc-update). Merge feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 to main.

Follow docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md exactly.

Key steps:
1. Verify git branch --show-current == feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821
2. git status — stage any uncommitted files by explicit path (never git add -A)
3. git fetch origin main
4. git rebase origin/main — if CONFLICT: resolve, continue, report in result.issues at MINOR. If CONFLICT you cannot resolve: STOP and FAIL.
5. git push -f origin feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 (force push allowed after rebase — standard for rebase workflows)
6. gh pr create --title 'REQ-070: Router decomposition into per-subsystem sub-routers (OQ-1)' --body 'Resolves stage-4-api-surface.md OQ-1. Decomposes lib/letflow/router.ex into Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline (shared middleware) and 10 per-subsystem stub sub-routers under /api/v1. GET /health preserved byte-compatibly outside the tenant-scoped pipeline. All 6 ACs verified: 1400/1400 tests passing.' --base main --head feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821
7. Merge: gh pr merge <pr-number> --squash --auto (or --merge if squash not available). No human approval required — all gates green.
8. After merge: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
9. Verify HEAD on main == the merge commit. Run: git log --oneline -3 main.
10. Clean up: git branch -d feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 (local only — remote branch auto-deleted on merge if configured, otherwise leave it)

No CI to wait for (REQ-013 is still pending — the 'CI green' precondition is satisfied by the 1400/1400 local test run already reported by TEST-RUNNER and RELEASE-VALIDATOR).

PowerShell note: gh and git commands print info to stderr which triggers PowerShell's 'NativeCommandError' false alarm. Check $LASTEXITCODE and the actual output content rather than the 'Command exited with code' line.

Complete the handoff: status COMPLETED, result.status PASS or FAIL, result.git_evidence with pr_url, merge commit SHA, push_status. next_action 'DONE — ORCH logs completion and releases queue lock'.
